ep1.s1: Long, long ago, every child in the Land of Dreams had a 'Dream Gem' of their very own.
ep1.s2: When the Dream Gem sparkled, they found things they wanted to do, and studying felt like an adventure.
ep1.s3: But one day, the ground shook and the whole world went dark…
ep1.mamba1: I am the Black Mamba! I'm the one who gets in the way of your dreams and studies. This gem is mine now!
ep1.s4: The Black Mamba stole the Dream Gem and vanished into the 'Tower of Darkness'. Without their gem, the children forgot what they wanted to do.
ep1.s5: One night, a golden door opened in front of the four friends.
ep1.angel1: Hi! I'm Sparkle, the starlight spirit who woke up inside the Golden Compass!
ep1.angel2: We need your help to get the Dream Gem back! Come with me across the wilderness to find the Black Mamba!
ep1.angel3: The adventure has six stages. Get to know yourself, find your study energy, find your Black Mamba, beat it with your own strategy… and we'll get the Dream Gem back!
ep1.partyI: It's way more fun when we all go together!
ep1.partyS: Slow and steady, so nobody gets hurt~
ep1.partyC: Route calculated. We're good to go.
ep1.n2: Just then, something came slinking out of the sand.
ep1.devil1: Sssso~ why walk through this hot wilderness? Let's rest here for just 5 minutes~
ep1.devilRest: Hehe, 5 minutes turns into 50 before you know it~
ep1.angelRest: Rest is important too! But let's decide how many minutes first. Then Slinky can't beat us!
ep1.devilGo: Hmph… next time I'll get you for sure!
ep1.angelGo: Awesome! You just beat a temptation. Confidence gauge UP!
ep1.angel4: More temptations like Slinky will show up. But as long as we're together, we'll be fine. Next episode, let's find out what kind of traveler you are!
ep1.sI: Around that time, there were friends shining in their own places. The Empathy Mage cast spells that made friends laugh,
ep1.sD: the Flame Knight always led the way, training alongside friends,
ep1.sS: the Pat-Pat Healer stayed by sick friends and comforted their hearts,
ep1.sC: and the AI Strategist solved hard problems step by step with an AI buddy.
ep1.s6: By day a cloud shaded them from the hot sun, and by night a firelight showed them the way. The travelers' adventure had begun!
ep1.selfI: Ta-da! I'm the Empathy Mage. My magic reads friends' hearts and makes everyone smile!
ep1.selfD: I'm the Flame Knight! I'll lead the way through anything hard. Follow me, everyone!
ep1.selfS: I'm the Pat-Pat Healer. Whenever a friend is having a hard time, I'll be right there to comfort them.
ep1.selfC: I'm the AI Strategist. With my Quick-Calc AI, I can solve any problem step by step.

ep2.intro1: To cross the wilderness, first you need to know yourself. What kind of traveler are you?
ep2.intro2: There are 24 questions. For each one, pick the ONE that sounds most like you. There are no wrong answers, so be honest!
ep2.tieTitle: Both characters are part of you!
ep2.tieFirst: Which character do you want to adventure with?
ep2.tieSecond: Which one feels like your second side?
ep2.subLine: And you have a little bit of the {job}, too!
ep2.angelResult: Wow! Now you have your very own character. Remember your strengths and growth keywords!
